notes: «كلهم بهذا الإسناد مثله» closes the three main routes: the back-reference is their shared tail; the report has no matn of its own
«وفي رواية شعبة عن سليمان قال سمعت ذكوان» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, never a route of the main three
«يعني ابن الحارث» is an editor's gloss on Khalid: left out
